changes: No substantive changes. Checked the scribe's name and title, the NS 810 → c. 1690 CE conversion, the month, pakṣa, tithi and weekday. Added a note on the Newari phrase 'thva kuhnu'.

notes: The scribe's name is written pītāmbale(!)na, with Newari l in place of r, for Pītāmbareṇa. The month ākhādha is a corrupt spelling of Āṣāḍha, and the weekday sva(!)mavāsare stands for somavāsare (Monday). 'thva kuhnu saṃpūrṇadine' is Newari, 'on this day, the day of completion'. The colophon names no era, but NS is the right reading for a Newari manuscript dated saṃvat 810. Āṣāḍha falls in 1690 CE, so 1690 is the right year. The weekday has not been checked against the tithi.
